label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

reclassified.why: Checked by hand: the last page record shows the checkout with a Payment heading and the payment method buttons Card, PayPal and others (or the embedded payment form); the oracle counted only radio buttons as method choices.

findings.problem: After declining cookies, a discount sign-up popup with an email field opened and grabbed keyboard focus; I had to tab past the unlock-offer button to find the decline button, and focus then jumped back to the top of the page

Product cards have several unnamed controls: the wishlist button and a link are announced with no product name, and every add-to-cart button is just [name] al carro, so I could not tell which product it adds

Each product card has 6 to 7 tab stops (wishlist, empty link, colour swatch, product link, offer badge, add to cart), and the skip link only jumps to the top of main content, so reaching the first add-to-cart took about 20 tab presses
The mini cart showed Subtotal (0) and 0,00 $ right after adding the item, then changed to 1 item and 39,99 euros; focus landed on Close and the cart summary was not announced clearly

The embedded payment area has an unlabeled checkbox, and the country control shows [name] as plain text that does not open or change with Enter or arrow keys, so I could not choose United States; after the last field focus fell out to the top of the page

The checkout page only offers sign in, create account, PayPal and Google Pay at first, with name, email and country fields buried inside an embedded payment frame; I never found a clear guest-checkout step, shipping address step or labelled pay button by keyboard
